name: Source Sink
description: The second clip wells up from one point as a round bubble while the first streams away along curved field lines and drains into a second point, both pictures flowing like a field between two charges. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: source
params.description: Point the second clip wells up from (0..1, y down)

params.name: sink
params.description: Point the first clip drains into (0..1, y down)

params.name: flow
params.description: How far the pictures travel along the field lines

params.name: swirl
params.description: Spin of the flow around the two points, 0 for straight field lines

params.name: shading
params.description: Shadow and highlight along the rim of the bubble
